'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Jan Westergard LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''The meteorite is the source of the Light'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Username:''' Ghosttrain
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
